name: The Fake Alchemist
overview: One young man transported to another world. One young woman taken from home and put up for sale. One way forward: alchemy and a can-do attitude. Life’s tough in a dark fantasy world when you don’t have any combat powers. Life’s tougher when you’re a slave. But together—and with the right doses of analysis and patience—Paracelsus and Nora might just be able to make it work…
